item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Sep 27, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
The Arts Guild of Sonoma presents: A Harvest of Art, September 30–November 2, featuring Monica Kuhlman Jacobson’s Sea and Sand coastal photography, Deirdre Molloy’s distinctive mixed-media portraits, and new original works by Guild member artists. Reception Thursday November 2, 5-7PM. Meet the artists. Voted Best Gallery 2026 People's Choice Awards. Now in its 49th year, the Arts Guild of Sonoma is one of California’s longest-running artist cooperatives. The Guild showcases the creative voices of Bay Area artists through exhibitions, community engagement, and educational programs. A 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, the Guild is committed to supporting regional artists and fostering opportunities for young and emerging creators, including Sonoma Valley high school students. Gallery open to the public Wednesdays through Mondays 11am to 5pm.140 E Napa Street, Sonoma. www.artsguildofsonoma.org

item.title: Fall Wreath-Making — Sun Oct 4, 12:00 PM — Art Escape Sonoma
item.description:
Embrace the beauty of autumn and join us for a Fall Wreath-Making workshop that will leave your front door adorned with seasonal splendor! In this class you will learn how to create a lush and fragrant holiday wreath using a wire frame and foliage, branches, and other dried materials. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned crafter, this workshop offers a warm and welcoming environment for all skill levels.
Silvia Bagnacani is a professional artist, educator, and floral designer with a passion for celebrating the beauty of seasonal blooms. Known around Sonoma for her inspiring floral arranging and wreath-making workshops, Silvia thoughtfully sources local flowers and foliage to create stunning, nature-inspired designs.

item.title: Ukrainian BBQ and Beer Festival — Sun Oct 4, 1:00 PM — Ragle Ranch Regional Park
item.description:
Sebastopol World Friends presents an authentic Ukrainian BBQ (shashlik) and specially brewed Ukrainian beers: “Ukrainian IPA” from Crooked Goat Brewing, and “Zelensky’s Orange Juice” from John Kreidler a special friend of SWF. There will be plentiful Ukrainian snacks, BBQ, vegetarian options, beer, wine, and other beverages, Ukrainian music, and lots of fun. Proceeds support Sebastopol World Friends on-going efforts to fund renovation of a dormitory building in Chyhyryn, Ukraine (Sebastopol’s sister city) that will house hundreds of Internally Displaced People from areas of Ukraine who have been impacted by the war there. Tickets are $75 and are all inclusive. Tickets must be purchased in advance at https://www.tickettailor.com/events/sebastopolworldfriends/2286813. For more information and ticket links go to sebastopolwf.org. Slava Ukraini!
Source: Sebastopol Calendar

item.title: Festival Calentano — Sun Oct 4, 3:00 PM — Luther Burbank Center for the Arts
item.description:
Festival Calentano will be an unforgettable night of dancing in the LBC Pavillion. Dance to the sounds of Tierra Caliente and regional Mexican music with Humberto Plancarte’s Tierra Cali, a group from Michoacán known for its romantic style and signature Tierra Caliente sound. The celebration will also feature the high-energy sound of Alameños de la Sierra DMC, the musical tradition of Los Canarios de Michoacán, and the unmistakable technobanda rhythms of Banda Maguey. Festival Calentano será una gran noche de baile dedicada a los sonidos de Tierra Caliente y la música regional mexicana. Encabezando el festival estará Humberto Plancarte’s Tierra Cali, agrupación originaria de Michoacán reconocida por su estilo romántico y su característico sonido calentano. La celebración también contará con la energía de Alameños de la Sierra DMC, la tradición musical de Los Canarios de Michoacán y el inconfundible ritmo technobanda de Banda Maguey.
